caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table positioned in the center of a plain, cream-colored background. The table is square-topped with a flat, brown surface, and it features a single drawer with a round knob on its front side. The table stands on a single central leg that splits into three angled feet at the base for support. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, giving a sense of depth and texture to the table. There are no other objects or notable features in the composition, except for faint shadows beneath the table and some minor marks on the background. The drawing is simple, focusing solely on the table and its structural details.
title: Shaker Peg Leg Stand
